audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Yasuo/Skill/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser against a packet levelChart of Yasuo/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Skill/Mordekaiser/Yasuo/Yasuo. audit.why: 51.54% over 1327 games: Mordekaiser wins 2-3 and the level-6 box, Yasuo takes it back on crit items. The chart handed Mordekaiser both item rows that its own captions give to Yasuo.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tldr and report[0].t both say Realm of Death 'removes his team and his Wind Wall value' — and the same page's spikes[1].text, mid and wants.you[2] all correctly say the opposite, that Wind Wall still exists inside the realm and still eats your Death's Grasp pull. The page contradicts itself on the single most important interaction in the matchup, and the wrong version is the one in the TL;DR. Separately, packet.defects flags that the content layer never names Yasuo's abilities: it writes 'Windwall' (not the real 'Wind Wall'), 'double-dash', 'ranged poke' and 'his knockup R' instead of Wind Wall, Sweeping Blade, Steel Tempest and Last Breath.
audit.why: A player who reads the TL;DR and ults expecting Wind Wall to be neutralised loses his E pull inside the box with no way out. The rest of the page already knows better.
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr and report[0].t to match the rest of the page — Wind Wall still works inside the realm, bait the 4-second wall before spending Death's Grasp — and kept the genuinely good existing point that Obliterate is a ground cone, not a projectile, so Wind Wall never blocked it. Normalised 'Windwall' to Wind Wall and replaced the paraphrases with Steel Tempest, Sweeping Blade and Last Breath.
sources: enemyKit W text 'blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds', blocksProjectiles flag
ownerKit Q text (ground smash, no projectile flag)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Last Breath as the matchup-defining cooldown with no seconds, and describes Wind Wall as lasting 'a few seconds'. Both numbers matter and both were missing: Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1 falling to 17s and stands for exactly 4 seconds; Last Breath is 70s at rank 1 but only 30s at rank 3, so 'track his ult' stops being a plan late. And Last Breath cannot be cast at all unless you are already airborne — which for a solo Yasuo means he must first land the 2-stack Steel Tempest whirlwind.
audit.why: The real trackable cooldown in this lane is Wind Wall, not Last Breath, and the page framed it the other way round.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with Wind Wall first (real cooldowns + 4s duration + what it does and does not block) and Last Breath second with its real 70s/30s and the airborne prerequisite. dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d now carry the same numbers and the knockup prerequisite.
sources: enemyKit R cd 70/50/30 + 'Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion'
enemyKit Q text 'At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne'

notes: This matchup's content layer is the best-written one in slice 6 — early already carries the exact Wind Wall interaction from the calibration list (Obliterate is a ground cone, not a projectile, so the wall never blocks it), which is the kind of thing most of these pages miss. The bug was that the full layer's tldr said the opposite. Worth noting the shape of the failure: the good fact lived only in the content prose, and the full layer's tldr was templated separately and never reconciled — the same split that produced the chart disagreements across this whole slice. Also unchanged: 'Windwall' spelled as one word still appears in early, mid, late and wants.foe[0]; I fixed it only where I was already editing the field, to avoid burning edits on a pure spelling pass.
